items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: About every month, Joe Allen would send him a stack of music like that.

ctx.x: Well, how many of them faked? Could they...

Almost all of them could play. Oh, yeah. Mm-hmm. But Manny didn't like it. He was a fellow that didn't like that playing by air. He didn't like it. Uh-uh. He wouldn't let Maurice get off and take hot choruses. No, he didn't care for that. He didn't like that. And Maurice said, play what you see. He used to make Maurice so angry. You just play what's on that paper. Maurice would get mad. We all would get mad because Maurice is a nice trumpet player, you know. He could get off, you know. But Manny would let it. And…
Well, I'd say comparing a band like Perez's band with Foster's brass band. Foster's brass band.
